I put the wallet on the table.
qián bāo

客: kè means guest.
今天有客人来我家。
Today a guest came to my house.
Usage: can mean guest or customer.

诚实: chéngshí means honest.
他是一个诚实的人。
He is an honest person.

贱人: jiàn rén means a low-life person.
他在众人面前说我是贱人。
He said I was a low-life in front of everyone.
Note: This term is highly offensive.

[合法]: [héfǎ] means [legal].
这个合同是合法的。
This contract is legal.

粉丝: fěn sī means a fan.
她是我的粉丝。
She is my fan.

级: jí means level, grade, or rank.
这本书有三个级别。
This book has three levels.

谢天谢地: xiè tiān xiè dì means thank heaven and earth; thank goodness.
谢天谢地，你终于回来了。
Thank goodness you finally came back.

救救: jiùjiù means to help or to rescue (someone) in distress.
他在危险中，请救救他。
He is in danger; please save him.
请救救我们的城市。

搜索: sōu suǒ means to search; to look for.
我在网上搜索了一下这本书的评价。
I searched online for reviews of this book.

好久: Hǎo jiǔ means for a long time.
我好久没看到你了。
I haven't seen you for a long time.
Usage: 常用于描述时间间隔很长。

[工厂]: [gōngchǎng] means [factory].
这家工厂正在生产新的产品。
This factory is producing new products.

留给: liú gěi means to leave for someone; to reserve for someone; to give to (someone).
我把这本书留给你。
I left this book for you.

走运: zǒu yùn means lucky; to be fortunate.
他今天真走运，竟然捡到了钱。
He is really lucky today and actually found money.

吸毒: xīdú means to use illegal drugs. 
他因为吸毒而被警方逮捕。 
He was arrested by the police for using illegal drugs.

独立: dúlì means independent.
她现在已经独立生活。
She now lives independently.

到来: dàolái means arrival.
新年的到来让大家感到兴奋。
The arrival of the new year makes everyone excited.

查查: cha cha means to check; to look up. 
我再查查这个词的意思。 
I will look up the meaning of this word again. 
Usage: casual, spoken Chinese.

决赛: juésài means final (the last round of a competition).
我们明天参加决赛。
We will participate in the final tomorrow.

[食]: [shí] means [to eat; food].
民以食为天。
People regard food as the most important thing.
民以食为天。

手段: shǒu duàn means means or tactic.
他用各种手段来达到目的。
He uses various means to achieve his goal.

扣: kòu means buckle; to fasten.
我需要把安全带扣好。
I need to fasten my seat belt.
他在外套上扣好了扣子。

顾客: gùkè means customer.
商店里的顾客排成队等待结账。
The customers in the store are lining up to check out.

农场: nóngchǎng means farm.
我们去农场喂牛。
We go to the farm to feed the cows.

网络: wǎngluò means the Internet.
我每天都使用网络学习新知识。
I use the Internet every day to learn new things.

口袋: kǒudài means pocket.
我把钥匙放进口袋里。
I put the keys into my pocket.

方便: fāngbiàn means convenient.
这个地图应用用起来很方便。
This map app is very convenient to use.

时机: shíjī means opportunity.
现在是抓住时机的时候。
Now is the time to seize the opportunity.
把握时机很重要。

存: cún means to exist; to store; to keep.
我把重要的文件存进了云端。
I stored the important files in the cloud.

毛病: máo bìng means fault or defect; problem.
我的手机有毛病。
My phone has a problem.
Note: Use 毛病 for faults or problems in objects or situations.

香: xiāng means fragrant.
这个花真的很香。
This flower is really fragrant.

印度: yìndù means India.
我计划明年去印度旅行。
I plan to travel to India next year.
我也想了解印度的文化。

交流: jiāoliú means communication and exchange.
我们在学校里学习如何有效地交流。
We learn how to communicate effectively at school.
Note: 交流 can refer to both speaking and exchanging ideas.

辩护: biàn hù means defense.
他聘请律师为自己进行辩护。
He hired a lawyer to defend himself.

打扮: dǎ bàn means to dress up.
她今天特地打扮得很漂亮。
She dressed up very nicely today.
Note: 同义词有装扮、打扮。

晕: yùn means dizzy.
我有点儿晕，得坐下休息一会儿。
I feel a bit dizzy and need to sit down to rest for a while.
Note: used in phrases such as 晕车 or 晕船.

[黄]: [huáng] means [yellow].
这辆车是黄的。
This car is yellow.

起码: qǐmǎ means at least.
我们起码需要三天才能完成这个项目。
We at least need three days to finish this project.

嫌犯: xiánfàn means suspect.
警方已经逮捕了嫌犯。
The police have arrested the suspect.

公开: gōngkāi means to make something public / to disclose / open to the public.
政府决定将这项信息公开。
The government decided to make this information public.
Pinyin: gōngkāi

行李: xínglǐ means luggage.
我的行李很重，需要帮忙搬运。
My luggage is very heavy and I need help to move it.
Usage: 行李 refers to luggage or baggage.

玛丽: Mǎlì means Mary.
我认识一个朋友叫玛丽。
I know a friend named Mary.
I know someone named Mary.

宁愿: níngyuàn means would rather.
我宁愿在家看书，也不去外面跑步。
I would rather stay at home and read, than go out for a run.
níngyuàn

隐瞒: yǐnmán means to conceal the truth.
他试图隐瞒真相。
He tried to conceal the truth.
Usage: verb

观点: guāndiǎn means viewpoint.
她在讨论中表达了不同的观点。
She expressed a different viewpoint in the discussion.
Note: 观点 can also mean "opinion" in general.

地板: dìbǎn means floor.
客厅的地板很干净。
The living room floor is very clean.

悲伤: bēishāng means sadness or grief.
我听到消息后感到很悲伤。
I felt very sad after hearing the news.
这份悲伤需要时间慢慢治愈。

尖叫: jiān jiào means to scream.
听到尖叫，他立刻跑过去。
Upon hearing the scream, he ran over immediately.
Pinyin: jiān jiào

网上: wǎng shàng means online.
我常在网上学习中文。
I often study Chinese online.

说不定: shuō bu dìng means maybe / perhaps.
说不定我今晚就去看电影了。
Maybe I will go to the movies tonight.

小丑: xiǎochǒu means clown.
舞台上有一个小丑正在表演。
There is a clown performing on the stage.

剧: jù means drama.
这部剧很感人。
This drama is very moving.
Pinyin: jù

小说: xiǎoshuō means novel.
我喜欢读小说。
I like reading novels.
xiǎoshuō

年龄: niánlíng means age.
我的年龄是二十岁。
My age is twenty years old.
Usage: 用于询问或说明年龄。

交换: jiāohuàn means exchange, to swap.
他们把书和笔记本交换了。
They exchanged books and notebooks.

雪: xuě means snow.
今早我发现院子里有雪。
This morning I found snow in the yard.

符合: fú hé means conform to; be in line with; meet (standards).
这项设计符合安全标准。
This design meets safety standards.

拥抱: yōngbào means hug.
他给了她一个温暖的拥抱。
He gave her a warm hug.

万一: wàn yī means in case / just in case.
万一明天下雨，我们就改天出发。
If it rains tomorrow, we'll set off on another day.

社区: shequ means community.
我住在一个友好的社区里。
I live in a friendly community.
我们的社区有很多活动。

助理: zhùlǐ means assistant.
她在公司担任助理，负责安排日程。
She works as an assistant at the company, responsible for arranging the schedule.

发明: fā míng means to invent.
他发明了一种新工具。
He invented a new tool.
Common collocations: 发明家, 发明创造

通话: tōnghuà means phone call or telephone conversation.
我昨天和朋友通话了解情况。
I talked with a friend on the phone yesterday to understand the situation.

贵: guì means expensive.
这件衣服真贵。
This piece of clothing is very expensive.

交通: jiāotōng means traffic; transportation.
今天的交通很拥挤。
Today's traffic is very crowded.
我正在研究城市的公共交通系统。

演唱: yǎnchàng means to sing; to perform (a song).
她在学校的演唱比赛中获奖。
She won a prize in her school's singing contest.
She won a prize in her school's singing contest.

重大: zhòngdà means major.
这是一项具有重大影响的决定。
This is a decision with significant impact.
Usage: 常用于描述影响或重要性。

组合: zǔhé means combination.
我们需要一个新的组合来解决这个问题。
We need a new combination to solve this problem.

思想: sī xiǎng means thoughts and thinking.
他的思想正在发生改变。
His thoughts are changing.

唱片: chàng piàn means record (audio recording).
我最近买了一张新唱片。
I recently bought a new record.
当然也可以说：我喜欢在周末听唱片。

骑士: qíshì means knight.
他是一名勇敢的骑士。
He is a brave knight.
He is a brave knight.

洗手间: xǐ shǒu jiān means bathroom.
请问，洗手间在哪儿？
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Pronunciation: xǐ shǒu jiān

的: de means a possessive/modifying particle.
Dee, it's mine
这是我的书。
This is my book.
